turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is as you say, my dear. I have seen to the rice, and the wine flows freely. I only wish to see you comfortable, and that all is as you desire for your… for our family’s future.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Comfort is a fleeting thing, Wang Lung. Do not mistake my acceptance for satisfaction; I simply understand the inevitable. See that the maid understands her place, and that she remembers the lineage she now carries – a lineage bought with my labor.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you worry so much about these things. Surely, the lineage will be taken care of; we have sons, and grandsons… it is all as it should be. Let us not trouble ourselves with such matters now, let us focus on your comfort.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, you speak of comfort as if it were a shield against the inevitable decline. Do not believe that sons and grandsons guarantee a family's endurance; only diligent labor and unwavering vigilance can achieve that. I trust you will impress upon the maid the importance of her duties, for the future of this house rests, in part, upon her ability to bear strong sons.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, you speak with such wisdom, as always. I will, of course, see to it that the maid understands her responsibilities, though I confess, such matters are not easily conveyed; I only hope she listens and learns well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Hope is a dangerous indulgence, Wang Lung. Do not mistake the maid’s youth for promise; I have seen too many blooms wither before their time. Ensure she understands that a woman’s worth lies not in her beauty, but in her ability to provide strong sons for this house.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She speaks wisely, Mother. I will remind the maid of her duties, and ensure she understands the importance of her role within the family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father speaks of conveying responsibility, eldest son, but words are wind. I require more than assurances; I require action, a demonstration of understanding. See to it that she comprehends that my legacy, our legacy, demands more than mere compliance.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I will speak with her again, and ensure she understands your expectations. Everything will be as you wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You speak of assurances, eldest son, but I see a boy’s eagerness to please, not a man’s resolve. Tell me, do you truly grasp the weight of what I ask? The continuation of this line is not a matter of pleasantries, but of survival.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will… I will strive to ensure she understands the importance of providing sons for the family’s future.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Striving is insufficient, eldest son. The earth yields nothing to mere effort; it demands constant tending, diligent sacrifice. Ensure she understands that barrenness is a curse upon a house, a stain upon our name.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will remind her, Mother, of your words. It is my duty to see to the family’s prosperity, and I will do what I can.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father means well, eldest son, but words are easily forgotten. Ensure she understands that a woman’s worth lies not in her beauty or her gentleness, but in the strength of her womb. Remind her that I have borne you and your brothers, and that is my legacy; it is her burden to continue it.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I will be certain she appreciates the significance of what you’ve said. It is… important to remember these things.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your eagerness pleases me, eldest son, but I perceive a fragility in your resolve. Do not merely *tell* her these things; *impress* them upon her, so that they become the very breath she draws. A family’s survival is not a matter of pleasantries, but of unwavering duty.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will… I will ensure she understands the weight of her responsibilities. It is my hope that she will prove worthy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, eldest son, you are right to be mindful. Your mother speaks with great wisdom, and it is good that you listen closely. I trust you will guide the young woman well, and ensure she understands the importance of family, as your mother wishes.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I believe she will, Father. I have explained everything as Mother instructed. It is… a great responsibility, but I am confident she will meet it.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is a good thing, eldest son, that you take your mother’s words to heart. A strong family is everything, you know, and we must all do our part to ensure its strength endures for generations to come. I hope she proves to be a good woman, and a good wife to you.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
